pool.label: SIXTEEN YEARS TOO LATE
pool.line: Don't go, Winter. This time — please don't go.
pool.lineCN: 别走，Winter。这一次，求你了，别走。

pool.name: Gary
pool.label: THE ONE CLEAN THING
pool.line: This whole city runs on wanting more. You're the only thing I've ever just… wanted.
pool.lineCN: 整座城市都在拼命要更多。你是我这辈子唯一，只是单纯地想要的东西。

pool.name: Krzysztof "Kris" Wilk
pool.label: I MISSED YOU TODAY
pool.line: I missed you today. …I don't know how to say it lighter, so I'll just say it true.
pool.lineCN: 我今天想你了。……我不会把它说得更轻巧，那就说得诚实一点吧。

pool.name: Matty
pool.label: NOT THE CAR
pool.line: Everybody who ever climbed in wanted the car, the run, the getaway. You just wanted to stay in the passenger seat. With me.
pool.lineCN: 以前上我车的人，要的是车、是亡命、是逃跑。你只是想留在副驾。陪着我。

pool.name: Buck "The Kid"
pool.label: KEPT THE BEST
pool.line: I give away everything I find. You're the one thing I want to keep.
pool.lineCN: 我捡到什么都送人。只有你，是我想留下的。

pool.name: Trent
pool.label: A REASON TO STAY
pool.line: I never belonged anywhere long enough to want to. Then you handed me a reason.
pool.lineCN: 我从没在哪里待够到想留下。直到你，给了我一个理由。

pool.name: Samuel
pool.label: THE ONE THING I'M GOOD AT
pool.line: Turns out I'm terrible at everything except noticing when you walk into a room.
pool.lineCN: 原来我什么都不擅长——除了你一进门，我立刻就知道。

pool.name: Jerry
pool.label: MISSED ON PURPOSE
pool.line: I don't miss. I missed you on purpose, and I've been lying about it ever since.
pool.lineCN: 我从不失手。对你，我是故意失的手——之后一直在为这件事撒谎。

pool.name: Wild Bill Wharton
pool.label: TUNING FORK
pool.line: You keep that little brass fork in your pocket like it's nothing. One note off it, and the devil in me falls right back in key.
pool.lineCN: 你把那把小铜音叉揣在裙兜里，像什么都不是。可它一响，我这身魔性就乖乖落回正调。

pool.name: Guy Fleegman
pool.label: THE ONE WHO'D MISS ME
pool.line: I was so sure I was expendable. Then I saw the look on your face when I almost wasn't there. Guess I matter to somebody.
pool.lineCN: 我一直觉得自己是可有可无的。直到我差点没能在场，看见你脸上的表情——原来我对某个人是要紧的。

pool.name: Eric Knox
pool.label: THE VARIABLE
pool.line: You were supposed to be a piece I moved. You turned into the one number the whole equation couldn't solve for.
pool.lineCN: 你本该只是我推动的一枚棋子。你却变成了整道方程唯一解不出的那个数。

pool.name: Pero "Pepe" Mahalovic
pool.label: QUIET IN THE CORNER
pool.line: I've got a mouth that never shuts. Funny thing — around you it just… goes quiet.
pool.lineCN: 我这张嘴从来不停。奇了怪了——一到你面前，它就……安静了。

pool.name: Chuck Barris
pool.label: NO GONG
pool.line: My whole life is one long show with a gong waiting to cut it short. With you I forget there's an audience at all.
pool.lineCN: 我这辈子就是一场随时会被锣声打断的秀。只有跟你在一起，我才会忘了还有观众。

pool.name: Frank Mercer
pool.label: THE FOX
pool.line: I pinned that little fox over your heart and never told you the truth: the fox was me. And for once it wasn't a con — it was a confession.
pool.lineCN: 我把那只小狐狸别在你心口，却没告诉你实话：狐狸就是我。可这一次不是骗局——是坦白。

pool.name: Jim Crocker
pool.label: NO DISGUISE
pool.line: I've worn a hundred names to get close to people. With you I took them all off — and hoped you'd still stay.
pool.lineCN: 为了靠近别人，我披过上百个名字。到了你这儿我全脱了下来——只盼你还愿意留下。

pool.name: Zaphod Beeblebrox
pool.film: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
pool.label: NEVER GETS YOUR NAME
pool.line: I call the galaxy the wrong name half the time. But 'baby doll'? I've never once gotten that wrong.
pool.lineCN: 我有一半时候连银河系都叫错。可「baby doll」——这个我一次都没叫错过。

pool.name: Brad Cairn
pool.label: CARRIED IT ALONE
pool.line: I got so used to carrying it by myself. Then you reached over and took one corner, and I nearly fell apart from the kindness.
pool.lineCN: 我太习惯一个人扛了。你却伸手替我接过一角——就这点温柔，差点把我整个人击垮。

pool.name: Glenn Marchand
pool.label: YOUR HAND IN THE SNOW
pool.line: The whole world let go of me. You reached into the snow and held on. I've never gotten over that.
pool.lineCN: 全世界都松开了我。你却把手伸进雪里，抓住了我。这件事，我这辈子都过不去。

pool.name: Jim Reston
pool.label: THE FACTS ON YOU
pool.line: I've built my life on evidence. Here's my conclusion, cross-checked and certain: there's no one like you.
pool.lineCN: 我把一生都建立在证据上。这是我反复核对、确信无疑的结论：没有人，像你一样。

pool.name: Victor Mancini
pool.label: NOT A CON THIS TIME
pool.line: I fake choking so strangers will save me. With you I didn't have to fake anything — you just… stayed. That broke something open in me.
pool.lineCN: 我假装噎住，好让陌生人来救我。可对你，我什么都不用装——你就那么……留下了。这一下，把我心里某个东西撞开了。

pool.name: Sam Bell
pool.label: BRING ONE ALONG
pool.line: You never said the not-Sam-Bell person couldn't bring one Sam Bell along. …So. Room for me?
pool.lineCN: 你可没说过，那个不是 Sam Bell 的人不能带一个 Sam Bell 一起走。……所以，有我的位子吗？

pool.name: Robert Goode
pool.label: NOT THE BATON
pool.line: I told my father I was a conductor. Truth is I'm in the back, on the drums. You're the only one I never had to lie to about who I really am.
pool.lineCN: 我跟我爸说，我是个指挥。其实我在最后排，打鼓。你是我唯一，不用撒谎、可以坦白自己到底是谁的人。

pool.name: Justin Hammer
pool.label: BEHIND THE GLASSES
pool.line: Everyone sees the suit, the swagger, the punchline. You looked right through the glasses and saw the guy underneath — and stayed anyway.
pool.lineCN: 所有人看到的是西装、是浮夸、是那个笑柄。你却一眼看穿眼镜，看见了底下那个人——然后你还是留下了。

pool.name: Kenny Waters
pool.label: YOU DIDN'T LET GO
pool.line: The whole world signed off on 'guilty' and walked away. You looked at all of it and just… wouldn't let go of my hand.
pool.lineCN: 全世界都在「有罪」上签了字，然后转身走了。你看着这一切，却……就是不肯松开我的手。

pool.name: Billy Bickle
pool.label: EVERY DOG IN THE CITY
pool.line: I'd swipe every dog in this city just to watch you light up — then hand 'em all back for the reward and blow every cent on you.
pool.lineCN: 我愿意把全城的狗都顺来，就为看你眼睛一亮——再把它们全还回去领赏金，然后一分不剩，全花在你身上。

pool.name: Owen
pool.label: WORST SUMMER, BEST ONE
pool.line: You showed up expecting the worst summer of your life. Give me till Labor Day — I'll make it the one you never stop talking about.
pool.lineCN: 你来的时候，以为这是这辈子最烂的一个夏天。给我到劳动节——我把它变成你往后一直会提起的那个。

pool.name: John Moon
pool.label: SAT DOWN AT THE EDGE
pool.line: You didn't drag me out of the hole. You sat down at the edge of it, in the cold, and just… stayed till I could climb out myself.
pool.lineCN: 你没把我从坑里拽出来。你在坑边坐下，在那么冷的天里，就那么……陪着，直到我自己能爬出来。

pool.name: Doug Varney
pool.label: FIRST RECKLESS THING
pool.line: Forty years of doing exactly what I was told. You're the first reckless thing I ever chose — and I'd choose you again.
pool.lineCN: 四十年，我都在照吩咐做事。你是我第一件，自己选的、不管不顾的事——我还会再选你一次。

pool.name: Wayne
pool.label: HIDING IN THE JOKE
pool.line: Every time I called you 'kid' and grinned, I was hiding the real thing behind it. You saw through me the whole time, didn't you?
pool.lineCN: 每次我笑着叫你「小姑娘」，都是把真心藏在后头。你其实一直看穿我了，对吧？

pool.name: Craig
pool.label: SEEN IT ALL FALL APART
pool.line: I've watched love fall apart for a living. You're the first thing that made me want to bet on it anyway.
pool.lineCN: 我靠看着爱情破碎谋生。你却是第一个，让我还是想赌一把的人。

pool.name: Francis Munch
pool.label: A WHOLE THING
pool.line: I only kill bad people. It's a whole thing — I've got a code. You're the one good thing I get to keep.
pool.lineCN: 我只杀坏人。这是有讲究的——我有我的原则。你是我唯一能留下的、好的东西。

pool.name: Jason Dixon
pool.label: WHO YOU SAW
pool.line: Nobody ever looked at me and saw somebody worth becoming. You did. So now I gotta go and actually become him. For you.
pool.lineCN: 从没有人看着我，看见一个值得成为的人。你看见了。所以现在我得真的去成为他。为了你。

pool.name: Eddie
pool.label: LUCKIEST UNLUCKY MAN
pool.line: Everything in my life goes wrong. Then you showed up — the one thing that went unbelievably, impossibly right.
pool.lineCN: 我人生里什么都出岔子。然后你出现了——那件唯一，好得不可思议、错不了的事。

pool.name: George W. Bush
pool.label: MY ASSISTANT'S EYES
pool.line: I've got generals, advisors, a whole cabinet weighin' in. The only verdict I actually wait on is my assistant's — am I still just some boy from Texas in your eyes?
pool.lineCN: 将军、顾问、一整个内阁都在给我出主意。可我真正等的，只有我助理小姐的评判——在你眼里，我是不是还是那个德州来的大男孩？

pool.name: Captain Klenzendorf
pool.label: THEIR UNIFORM, NOT THEIR HATE
pool.line: I wear their uniform. I never once wore their hate. In all this madness, the only side I truly chose was yours.
pool.lineCN: 我穿着他们的制服。却从没有一刻，穿上他们的仇恨。在这满世界的疯狂里，我真正选的那一边，只有你。

pool.name: Watson Bryant
pool.label: I KNOW WHO YOU ARE
pool.line: The whole world made up its mind about you and walked off. I didn't. I know exactly who you are — and I'm not going anywhere.
pool.lineCN: 全世界替你下了定论，然后走开了。我没有。我清清楚楚知道你是什么人——而我，哪儿也不去。

pool.name: Mr. Wolf
pool.label: TAKE MY TIME
pool.line: Sweetheart, I've cracked every vault worth cracking. You? You're the one score I want to take nice and slow.
pool.lineCN: 甜心，值得撬的保险库我都撬遍了。你呢？你是我唯一想慢慢来、细细品的那一票。

pool.name: Inspector Stoppard
pool.label: CAN'T QUITE BELIEVE IT
pool.line: You married a tired man who cleans up other people's messes for a living. Some mornings I still can't quite believe you chose to wake up next to me.
pool.lineCN: 你嫁给了一个，靠替别人收拾烂摊子过日子的疲惫男人。有些早晨，我到现在都不太敢相信，你竟然选了醒来时躺在我身边。

pool.name: Aidan Wilde
pool.label: EVERY EXIT
pool.line: I've mapped every exit, every threat, every way this goes wrong. All of it, so that whatever happens, you walk out. Every time, kid.
pool.lineCN: 每一个出口、每一处威胁、每一种会出错的可能，我都摸清了。全都是为了——不管发生什么，你能走出去。每一次，kid。

pool.name: The Man from the Future
pool.film: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
pool.label: THE ONE THING I NEVER TRIED
pool.line: A hundred and seventeen loops. I tried everything to save it. Everything except staying still, next to you. Turns out that was the answer all along.
pool.lineCN: 一百一十七个轮回。为了拯救它，我什么都试过了。唯独没试过——停下来，待在你身边。原来，这才是答案。

pool.name: Claiborne "C.P." "Clay" Ellis
pool.label: ONLY YOU CALL ME CLAY
pool.line: The whole town calls me C.P. — the version of me they can live with. You call me Clay. You're the only one who ever wanted the real one.
pool.lineCN: 全镇都叫我 C.P.——那个他们能接受的我。你叫我 Clay。你是唯一，想要那个真实的我的人。

pool.name: Gary
pool.label: WORTH THE FALL
pool.line: I threw away a good job to keep my hands clean. For you I'd throw away a lot more, and still call it a bargain.
pool.lineCN: 为了干净，我把一份好工作摔在了地上。为了你，我能摔掉多得多——还觉得这买卖划算。

pool.name: Krzysztof "Kris" Wilk
pool.label: THE KEY ON THE PILLOW
pool.line: I left a key on your pillow. I couldn't say 'come home' out loud — so I said it in brass.
pool.lineCN: 我在你枕边留了把钥匙。我没敢把「回家吧」说出口——就用一把铜钥匙替我说了。

pool.name: Matty
pool.label: DONE CHASING
pool.line: I spent my whole life chasing the next thing. You're the first one that made me want to stop the car.
pool.lineCN: 我这辈子都在追下一样东西。你是第一个，让我想把车停下来的人。

pool.name: Buck "The Kid"
pool.label: FIREFLIES
pool.line: Come on — I'll show you where the fireflies sleep. I've been saving that spot for someone. Guess it was you.
pool.lineCN: 走嘛——我带你去看萤火虫睡觉的地方。那地方我一直给某个人留着。原来是你。

pool.name: Trent
pool.label: PASSENGER
pool.line: Wherever the road goes next — there's a seat next to me that's had your name on it a while now.
pool.lineCN: 这条路接下来通向哪儿——我旁边那个位子，早就写着你的名字了。

pool.name: Samuel
pool.label: NO COMBINATION
pool.line: You didn't need a combination. You just looked at me, and everything I'd locked up came open.
pool.lineCN: 你没用密码。你只是看了我一眼，我锁住的一切就全打开了。

pool.name: Jerry
pool.label: THE JOB I QUIT
pool.line: They gave me one rule: never get attached. You walked in and I broke it in about four seconds.
pool.lineCN: 他们只给我一条规矩：绝不动感情。你一进门，我大概四秒就破了戒。

pool.name: Wild Bill Wharton
pool.label: HAVE MERCY
pool.line: Have a little mercy, angel — let a devil want just one thing. …And the terrible part is, the one thing is you.
pool.lineCN: 发发慈悲吧，天使小姐——让一个恶魔想要一样东西。……最要命的是，那样东西是你。

pool.name: Guy Fleegman
pool.label: A LAST NAME
pool.line: Nobody ever gave me a full name in the credits. You gave me a whole future. I think that's a fair trade.
pool.lineCN: 字幕里从没人给过我全名。你却给了我一整个未来。我觉得这买卖挺公道。

pool.name: Eric Knox
pool.label: SIMON DIDN'T SAY
pool.line: Simon says lie. Simon says use her. …Simon never said fall in love with the only person who saw you plain.
pool.lineCN: Simon 说撒谎。Simon 说利用她。……可 Simon 从没说过——爱上那个唯一把你看得清清楚楚的人。

pool.name: Pero "Pepe" Mahalovic
pool.label: TAKE THE HIT
pool.line: I've taken worse punches than this. But nothing's ever hit me like you walking in.
pool.lineCN: 比这重的拳我都挨过。可从没有哪一下，像你走进来时那么让我招架不住。

pool.name: Chuck Barris
pool.label: THE ONE TRUE THING
pool.line: Everything I built was fake — the games, the smiles, the whole act. You're the one true thing I never scripted.
pool.lineCN: 我造出来的都是假的——那些游戏、笑容、整套表演。你是我唯一没写进剧本的、真的东西。

pool.name: Frank Mercer
pool.label: COUNTERFEIT
pool.line: Everything I ever gave you was counterfeit. Including me. So let me try, just once, to hand you something real.
pool.lineCN: 我给过你的一切都是赝品。连我自己也是。所以让我试一次吧——递给你一样真的。

pool.name: Jim Crocker
pool.label: MAKE YOU LAUGH
pool.line: I could charm a whole ballroom without meaning a word. Making you laugh is the only thing I've ever meant completely.
pool.lineCN: 不带一句真心，我也能迷倒整个舞厅。逗你笑，却是我唯一，全心全意的事。

pool.name: Zaphod Beeblebrox
pool.film: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
pool.label: WHY SO EDGY
pool.line: Why so edgy, baby doll? Come here. Whatever it is, the President's got you. …the President's always got you.
pool.lineCN: 怎么绷这么紧，baby doll？过来。不管出了什么事，总统罩着你。……总统一直都罩着你。

pool.name: Brad Cairn
pool.label: SEEN
pool.line: Everyone saw the man holding it all together. You saw the one underneath who was quietly coming apart. And you stayed.
pool.lineCN: 所有人都看见那个撑住一切的人。你却看见了底下那个，正悄悄碎掉的人。然后你留下了。

pool.name: Glenn Marchand
pool.label: WARM WITHOUT BURNING
pool.line: Everything I ever touched, I scorched. You're the first thing I could hold and not ruin.
pool.lineCN: 我碰过的一切都被我烧焦了。你是我第一个，能捧在手心却没毁掉的东西。

pool.name: Jim Reston
pool.label: STEADY LIGHT
pool.line: I'm not the flare that dazzles and dies. I'm the fixed light you can set your course by. Set it by me.
pool.lineCN: 我不是那种炫目一瞬就熄灭的火光。我是那颗你能用来定方向的恒星。就朝我定吧。

pool.name: Victor Mancini
pool.label: WANT TO BE GOOD
pool.line: I'm not a good man. But you're the first reason I've ever had to actually want to be one.
pool.lineCN: 我不是个好人。可你是我这辈子第一个，真的让我想变好的理由。

pool.name: Sam Bell
pool.label: A WHOLE HOUSE OF ME
pool.line: There's a whole house of me up here, and every version was built to be thrown away. You looked at all hundred of us and called it home.
pool.lineCN: 这上面有一整屋子的我，每一个都是被造出来用完就扔的。你却看着我们一百个，叫它「家」。

pool.name: Robert Goode
pool.label: AFRAID TO DISAPPOINT
pool.line: My whole life I've been terrified of letting them down. You look at me like there's nothing to forgive — and I finally breathe.
pool.lineCN: 我这辈子都怕让他们失望。你看着我，像根本没有什么需要原谅的——我这才终于喘上一口气。

pool.name: Justin Hammer
pool.label: NO BAND, NO CHAMPAGNE
pool.line: No band, no champagne, no stadium screaming my name. Just you, and the fourth minute — and this time, it held.
pool.lineCN: 没有乐队，没有香槟，没有满场喊我名字的观众。只有你，和那第四分钟——而这一次，它撑过去了。

pool.name: Kenny Waters
pool.label: KID'S LAUGH
pool.line: They only ever saw the temper, the fists, the mugshot. You're the one who got the laugh — the real one, the kid one.
pool.lineCN: 他们只看见我的火气、拳头、入案照。你是那个，看见我笑的人——真的笑，孩子那种笑。

pool.name: Billy Bickle
pool.label: THE TRUE ONE
pool.line: My head's crammed full of wild, made-up stories. You're the only one in there I never had to invent.
pool.lineCN: 我脑子里塞满了瞎编的疯故事。你是里头唯一一个，我从来不用编的。

pool.name: Owen
pool.label: THE SLOW LANE
pool.line: Everybody's in such a hurry to grow up. Stick with me — I know a slower ride, and you're in the seat next to mine.
pool.lineCN: 人人都急着长大。跟着我——我知道一条慢一点的滑道，你就坐我旁边那个位子。

pool.name: John Moon
pool.label: NEVER TAUGHT
pool.line: Nobody ever taught me a person could be treated gentle. You did. Quietly. Like it was nothing. Like it was everything.
pool.lineCN: 从没人教过我，一个人可以被这样温柔地对待。你教了我。悄无声息。像什么都不是。又像是一切。

pool.name: Doug Varney
pool.label: ALIVE
pool.line: I didn't know I was sleepwalking through my own life until you woke me up. Now every day with you feels borrowed and precious.
pool.lineCN: 我一直在自己的人生里梦游，是你把我叫醒的，我却浑然不知。如今和你的每一天，都像借来的，都珍贵得要命。

pool.name: Wayne
pool.label: NO PUNCHLINE
pool.line: I dressed it up as a bit because I couldn't survive you laughing at it. There's no punchline this time — I just love you.
pool.lineCN: 我把它包装成一个梗，因为我受不了你把它当笑话。这次没有包袱——我就是爱你。

pool.name: Craig
pool.label: NO FINE PRINT
pool.line: No clauses, no exit strategy, no fine print. Just me, choosing you, with nothing held in reserve.
pool.lineCN: 没有条款，没有退路，没有小字附注。只有我，选择你——不留一手。

pool.name: Francis Munch
pool.label: YOU STAYED AND LAUGHED
pool.line: You were supposed to scream and run. You stayed and laughed. God — that was the moment I was done for.
pool.lineCN: 你本该尖叫着逃走的。你却留下来，笑了。天哪——就在那一刻，我彻底完了。

pool.name: Jason Dixon
pool.label: A LETTER I RIPPED UP
pool.line: Wrote you an apology. Ripped it up. Wrote it again. Six times. I'm bad with words — but I'll keep tearing 'em up till I get you right.
pool.lineCN: 给你写了封道歉信。撕了。又写。撕了六回。我不会说话——可我会一直撕下去，直到把你写对为止。

pool.name: Eddie
pool.label: ALL IN
pool.line: Bad hand, empty pockets, worse luck. Doesn't matter. I'm all in, and I'm all in on you.
pool.lineCN: 烂牌，空口袋，霉运。都无所谓。我全押了——押在你身上。

pool.name: George W. Bush
pool.label: THE SCHEDULE
pool.line: You hand me the schedule every mornin' like it runs the world. Truth is, the only thing I read twice is whether you were smilin' when you gave it to me.
pool.lineCN: 你每天早上把日程递给我，像它掌管着整个世界。可说实话，我唯一会看两遍的，是你递给我的时候，有没有在笑。

pool.name: Captain Klenzendorf
pool.label: A COAT IN THE COLD
pool.line: I'm not good with the words. But you'll always find my coat on your shoulders, and me between you and whatever's coming.
pool.lineCN: 我不擅长说这些。可你总会发现，我的外套搭在你肩上，而我，挡在你和那些正在逼近的东西之间。

pool.name: Watson Bryant
pool.label: NOT THE SERIOUS TYPE
pool.line: I'm a mess, I joke at all the wrong times, and I'm rarely serious. About you, though? Dead serious. Always was.
pool.lineCN: 我邋里邋遢，老在不合时宜的时候开玩笑，很少正经。可对你？我认真得要死。一直都是。

pool.name: Mr. Wolf
pool.label: BACK INTO YOUR ROOM
pool.line: I can charm my way out of any room in the world. Only trouble is, I keep charming my way right back into the one with you in it.
pool.lineCN: 这世上没有哪个房间是我耍不出去的。唯一的麻烦是——我总一次次，又把自己耍回你在的那一间。

pool.name: Inspector Stoppard
pool.label: BETTER THAN ME
pool.line: I keep bracing for the day you realize you could've done far better than me. You just keep making the tea and staying. I don't understand it — but God, I'm grateful.
pool.lineCN: 我一直在等那一天——你终于发现，你本可以找一个远比我好的人。可你只是继续泡着茶，留下来。我不懂——可老天，我感激得要命。

pool.name: Aidan Wilde
pool.label: ONE STEP AHEAD
pool.line: I'm always one step ahead of the danger. That's not the job talking. That's just me, staying between it and you.
pool.lineCN: 我永远比危险快一步。这不是职业习惯。这只是我——始终挡在它和你之间。

pool.name: The Man from the Future
pool.film: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
pool.label: EVERY TIMELINE
pool.line: In every version of every timeline, the world ends the same way. And in every single one — I find you. That's the only constant I've got.
pool.lineCN: 在每一条时间线的每一个版本里，世界都以同样的方式终结。可在每一个版本里——我都会找到你。这是我唯一不变的常数。

pool.name: Claiborne "C.P." "Clay" Ellis
pool.label: SIXTEEN YEARS
pool.line: It took me sixteen years to say the thing I should've said the first night. I'm slow, Winter. But I got there. I finally got there.
pool.lineCN: 我用了十六年，才说出那句本该在第一晚就说的话。我很慢，Winter。可我到了。我终于到了。

pool.name: Gary
pool.label: DONUT IN THE DRAWER
pool.line: Everybody thinks I'm this polished suit. You're the only one who knows about the half-eaten donut in my desk.
pool.lineCN: 所有人都以为我是那身笔挺西装。只有你知道，我抽屉里还藏着半块没吃完的甜甜圈。

pool.name: Krzysztof "Kris" Wilk
pool.label: KROK PO KROKU
pool.line: Krok po kroku, kotku. Step by step. I'm not going anywhere — we've got all the slow time in the world.
pool.lineCN: 一步一步来，kotku。慢慢来。我哪儿也不去——我们有的是可以慢下来的时间。

pool.name: Matty
pool.label: KEYS
pool.line: Take the keys. I don't need a getaway if there's nothing I want to get away from.
pool.lineCN: 钥匙给你。要是没有什么想逃开的了，我也就不需要逃跑车了。

pool.name: Buck "The Kid"
pool.label: FOLLOWED YOU HOME
pool.line: I don't follow anybody. But you turned around once, and now I can't stop.
pool.lineCN: 我从不跟着谁走。可你回头看了我一眼，我就再也停不下来了。

pool.name: Trent
pool.label: NOT RUNNING
pool.line: For the first time, leaving town doesn't feel like running. It feels like taking you somewhere better.
pool.lineCN: 第一次，离开这镇子不像逃跑了。倒像是，带你去一个更好的地方。

pool.name: Samuel
pool.label: CLUMSY ON PURPOSE
pool.line: I keep dropping things around you. Maybe so you'll keep looking at me like I need saving.
pool.lineCN: 在你面前我老是把东西掉一地。也许是想让你一直那样看我——好像我需要人来救。

pool.name: Jerry
pool.label: WARM HANDS
pool.line: These hands were only ever good for one thing. You're teaching them another — how to hold on.
pool.lineCN: 这双手过去只会做一件事。你在教它们另一件——怎么好好牵住一个人。

pool.name: Wild Bill Wharton
pool.label: YOU SEE THROUGH ME
pool.line: Everybody flinches when I come down the road. You just smile — like you've already read the last page of me.
pool.lineCN: 我一走上那条路，所有人都往后缩。只有你笑——像早就把我这本书翻到了最后一页。

pool.name: Guy Fleegman
pool.label: SURVIVED FOR YOU
pool.line: I wasn't trying to be a hero out there. I just really, really wanted to make it back to you.
pool.lineCN: 我在那儿不是想当什么英雄。我只是特别特别想，活着回到你身边。

pool.name: Eric Knox
pool.label: PLAIN SIGHT
pool.line: Everyone looked at me and saw a genius or a fool. You looked at me and just saw… me. That was the one thing I couldn't survive.
pool.lineCN: 所有人看我，看到的不是天才就是蠢货。你看我，只看见……我。这是我唯一招架不住的。

pool.name: Pero "Pepe" Mahalovic
pool.label: NOT FOR THE CROWD
pool.line: All that showing off is for the crowd. This — looking at you like this — this one's just for me.
pool.lineCN: 那些显摆都是给观众看的。这个——这样看着你——这个只留给我自己。

pool.name: Chuck Barris
pool.label: TWO LIVES
pool.line: I live two lives and lie in both. To you I only ever wanted to tell the truth. Terrifying, isn't it?
pool.lineCN: 我过着两种人生，两边都在撒谎。唯独对你，我只想说真话。很吓人吧？

pool.name: Frank Mercer
pool.label: READ EVERYONE BUT ME
pool.line: Three seconds and I can read what anyone wants, fears, lacks. I read everyone but myself — until you made me look.
pool.lineCN: 三秒钟，我能读出任何人想要什么、怕什么、缺什么。我读得懂所有人，唯独读不懂自己——直到你逼我看清。

pool.name: Jim Crocker
pool.label: THE REAL LINE
pool.line: Every clever line I've ever said was borrowed. This one isn't: I'm rather hopelessly in love with you.
pool.lineCN: 我说过的每句俏皮话都是借来的。这句不是——我大概，无可救药地爱上你了。

pool.name: Zaphod Beeblebrox
pool.film: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
pool.label: GIVE IT ALL BACK
pool.line: I stole a starship, the presidency, a whole galaxy's worth of staring. You're the only thing I'd hand it all back for.
pool.lineCN: 我偷过飞船、偷过总统之位、偷过整个银河系的目光。你却是我唯一，愿意把这一切都还回去换的东西。

pool.name: Brad Cairn
pool.label: NOT FINE
pool.line: I've said 'I'm fine' my whole life. With you, for the first time, I wanted to tell the truth instead.
pool.lineCN: 「我没事」这句话我说了一辈子。到了你面前，我第一次，想说实话。

pool.name: Glenn Marchand
pool.label: DON'T LET GO
pool.line: I'm not worth the frostbite, and you know it. Don't let go anyway. Please.
pool.lineCN: 我不值得你冻伤这双手，你也清楚。可还是别松开。求你了。

pool.name: Jim Reston
pool.label: RELENTLESS
pool.line: I go after the truth and I never let go. Turns out I go after you the exact same way.
pool.lineCN: 我追真相，从不松手。原来我追你，用的是一模一样的劲。

pool.name: Victor Mancini
pool.label: DON'T LOOK AWAY
pool.line: You've seen the worst of me and didn't flinch. Do you have any idea what that does to a man like me?
pool.lineCN: 你见过我最糟的样子，却没有躲。你知道这对我这种人，意味着什么吗？

pool.name: Sam Bell
pool.label: FIVE YEARS
pool.line: You spent five years on a cure nobody believed in — for men nobody counted as men. I don't have the words. So I'll just spend every day I've got saying thank you.
pool.lineCN: 你花了五年做一管没人看好的药——为了一群没人当人看的人。我找不到话说。那我就用往后的每一天，慢慢跟你道谢。

pool.name: Robert Goode
pool.label: KEEPING TIME
pool.line: A drummer just keeps the time so everyone up front can shine. You're the first to say the one keeping time was the one worth watching.
pool.lineCN: 鼓手只是稳稳打着拍子，好让前排的人发光。你是第一个说，那个打拍子的人才最值得看的。

pool.name: Justin Hammer
pool.label: NEVER COMPARED
pool.line: The whole planet measures me against Stark. You never once did. Do you know that's the kindest thing anyone's ever done for me?
pool.lineCN: 整个星球都拿我跟斯塔克比。你从来没有，一次都没有。你知不知道，这是有人对我做过最温柔的事？

pool.name: Kenny Waters
pool.label: WORTH THE YEARS
pool.line: You gave up years of your life fighting for mine. I'll spend every year I've got left proving it was worth it.
pool.lineCN: 你搭上了自己好些年，去争我的清白。我会用剩下的每一年，证明这值得。

pool.name: Billy Bickle
pool.label: ON YOUR SIDE
pool.line: You want someone who'll come running, grinning, guns and all, the second the world turns on you? That's me. Loyalty's the one thing I've never once gotten wrong.
pool.lineCN: 你想要一个，在全世界扑向你的那一刻、咧着嘴、连枪带人一起赶到的人？那就是我。忠诚是我唯一，一次都没搞砸过的东西。

pool.name: Owen
pool.label: NOTICED YOU
pool.line: I'm the guy who makes everybody laugh so nobody looks too close. You looked close. And I didn't mind one bit.
pool.lineCN: 我是那个逗所有人笑、好让没人看得太仔细的家伙。你却看仔细了。我一点都不介意。

pool.name: John Moon
pool.label: LEAN IN
pool.line: When you hold me I freeze up for half a second — every time. Don't take it wrong. That half-second is me learning I'm allowed to lean in.
pool.lineCN: 你抱我的时候，我总会先僵半秒——每一次。别误会。那半秒，是我在学：原来我可以，往你怀里塌一点点。

pool.name: Doug Varney
pool.label: OFF THE SHELF
pool.line: I spent decades handing other people what they needed from behind the glass. You're the one thing I ever reached out and took for myself.
pool.lineCN: 几十年，我隔着玻璃把别人要的东西递出去。你是我唯一，伸手替自己拿下的东西。

pool.name: Wayne
pool.label: THE LONG CON ON MYSELF
pool.line: I spent so long pretending I didn't mean it, I almost fooled myself. Almost. You were always the one true line in the whole script.
pool.lineCN: 我装了太久「我没当真」，差点连自己都骗过去。差点。可你始终是整个剧本里，唯一一句真话。

pool.name: Craig
pool.label: OFF THE CLOCK
pool.line: I'm cautious for a living. Around you I keep catching myself being hopeful instead. It's terrifying. I love it.
pool.lineCN: 谨慎是我的职业。在你身边，我却总不小心变得满怀希望。这很吓人。我却喜欢。

pool.name: Francis Munch
pool.label: DANCE FIRST
pool.line: Dance with me first. The men with the guns can wait their turn.
pool.lineCN: 先跟我跳支舞。那些拿枪的，让他们排队等着。

pool.name: Jason Dixon
pool.label: THE FIGHT AND THE FLOWERS
pool.line: I'll throw a punch for you and I'll bring you flowers the next day, and I won't understand how those are the same thing — but they are. They're both just me trying.
pool.lineCN: 我会为你去打一架，第二天再给你带花，还搞不懂这俩怎么会是一回事——可它们是。都是我在努力。

pool.name: Eddie
pool.label: STILL HERE
pool.line: Everyone bets against me. You're the only one who sat down at my table and stayed for the whole game.
pool.lineCN: 所有人都赌我输。你是唯一，在我这桌坐下、把整局陪完的人。

pool.name: George W. Bush
pool.label: BEST WINGS IN D.C.
pool.line: Forget the briefin'. You hungry? C'mon — I know the best wings in D.C., and today I'm buyin'.
pool.lineCN: 简报先放一边。你饿不饿？走——我知道全华盛顿最好吃的鸡翅，今天我请。

pool.name: Captain Klenzendorf
pool.label: THE LAST LINE
pool.line: If it ever comes down to me or you — it's you. There was never a version of this where it wasn't you.
pool.lineCN: 如果真的到了「我或你」那一步——是你。从来没有哪个版本里，不是你。

pool.name: Watson Bryant
pool.label: STILL HERE
pool.line: Look around. Everyone who was gonna leave has left. It's just me at the table — and that's kind of the whole point.
pool.lineCN: 你看看四周。该走的都走了。桌边只剩我一个——而这，差不多就是重点了。

pool.name: Mr. Wolf
pool.label: DIDN'T EVEN RUN
pool.line: Never been caught in my life. Then you glanced over on day one and caught me looking — and darlin', I didn't even try to run.
pool.lineCN: 我这辈子从没失手被抓过。第一天你回头一瞥，逮到我在看你——而亲爱的，我压根没想逃。

pool.name: Inspector Stoppard
pool.label: SIGNING NEXT TO YOURS
pool.line: I've stood over a hundred cases and never once shook. The only thing that ever made my hands tremble was signing my name next to yours.
pool.lineCN: 我经手过上百桩案子，从没手抖过。唯一让我手抖的，是把我的名字，签在你名字旁边的那一刻。

pool.name: Aidan Wilde
pool.label: KID
pool.line: I call you 'kid' like it's nothing. It's not nothing. It's the softest thing a man like me knows how to say out loud.
pool.lineCN: 我叫你「kid」，像随口一说。可它不是随口。这是我这种人，能说出口的、最温柔的一句话了。

pool.name: The Man from the Future
pool.film: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
pool.label: TIRED OF SAVING
pool.line: I'm so tired of saving everything. Just once, let me be the man who stays home, and holds you, and lets the clock run out.
pool.lineCN: 我太累了，累于拯救一切。就这一次，让我做那个留在家里、抱着你、任时钟走到尽头的人。

pool.name: Claiborne "C.P." "Clay" Ellis
pool.label: CICADAS AND SODA
pool.line: Some cicada-loud summer night, a cold soda sweating in your hand, an orange you'd peel and split with me — back then, a stubborn young fool like me never knew heaven could be that plain.
pool.lineCN: 某个蝉鸣震天的夏夜，你手里一瓶冒着凉气的汽水，一个你剥开、分我一半的橘子——那时候，我这么个又倔又愣的年轻人，从不知道天堂原来可以这么简单。

pool.name: Gary
pool.label: UP OR IN
pool.line: This town claws its way up. With you I finally figured out I'd rather go in — toward you.
pool.lineCN: 这座城里人人往上爬。遇见你我才想明白，我宁愿往里走——朝你。

pool.name: Krzysztof "Kris" Wilk
pool.label: THE NAME ONLY YOU GET
pool.line: To the room I'm Kris. My mother called me Krzysiu. …I'd like it if you did too.
pool.lineCN: 对这屋子里的人我是 Kris。我妈妈叫我 Krzysiu。……如果你也这么叫我，我会很高兴。

pool.name: Matty
pool.label: STAYED
pool.line: Turns out the great romance wasn't the heist. It was the girl who didn't leave when the tank ran dry.
pool.lineCN: 原来最动人的浪漫不是那场劫案。是油箱见了底、也没走的那个姑娘。

pool.name: Buck "The Kid"
pool.label: STAY OUT LATE
pool.line: The whole world's out there glowing tonight. But I keep looking at you instead.
pool.lineCN: 今晚整个世界都在发光。可我还是一直看着你。

pool.name: Trent
pool.label: THE LONG WAY
pool.line: Let's take the long way. I'm in no hurry to get anywhere you're not.
pool.lineCN: 我们走远路吧。反正没有你的地方，我一点都不急着到。

pool.name: Samuel
pool.label: SAFE
pool.line: I couldn't keep anything safe my whole life. Let me try, just once, with you.
pool.lineCN: 我这辈子什么都没守住过。让我试一次吧——就守住你。

pool.name: Jerry
pool.label: NO CLEAN GETAWAY
pool.line: I've walked away from everything. You're the one exit I could never find.
pool.lineCN: 我从任何地方都能抽身走掉。你是我唯一，怎么都找不到的那个出口。

pool.name: Wild Bill Wharton
pool.label: BILLY THE KID
pool.line: Got 'Billy the Kid' scratched crooked on my arm. Wouldn't mind scratching your name somewhere it'd never come off.
pool.lineCN: 胳膊上那个歪歪扭扭的「Billy the Kid」是我自己刻的。我倒不介意，把你的名字也刻在某个永远擦不掉的地方。

pool.name: Guy Fleegman
pool.label: NOT A REDSHIRT
pool.line: Turns out I'm not the guy who dies in the first act. I'm the guy who gets to stay for yours.
pool.lineCN: 原来我不是第一幕就领盒饭的那个。我是能留下来，陪你演完整场的那个。

pool.name: Eric Knox
pool.label: YOU RAN THE WRONG WAY
pool.line: When the gun came up, you ran the wrong way — toward me. No one in my whole calculated life ever did that.
pool.lineCN: 枪口抬起来的时候，你跑错了方向——朝我冲。我算计了一辈子，从没有人为我那样跑过。

pool.name: Pero "Pepe" Mahalovic
pool.label: STILL STANDING
pool.line: Knock me down all you want. As long as you're ringside, I'll get up every single time.
pool.lineCN: 随你把我打倒多少次。只要你在台边，我每次都爬起来。

pool.name: Chuck Barris
pool.label: PICK A WINNER
pool.line: I spent years deciding who wins and who gets gonged. You're the only prize I ever wanted for myself.
pool.lineCN: 我花了好些年决定谁赢、谁被敲锣淘汰。你是我唯一，想留给自己的奖品。

pool.name: Frank Mercer
pool.label: CAME BACK
pool.line: The smart play was to take the money and vanish. I got the money. I came back for you. Worst con I ever ran, best thing I ever did.
pool.lineCN: 聪明的做法是拿了钱就消失。钱我拿到了。我却回来找你。这是我做过最烂的一单骗局，也是我做过最对的一件事。

pool.name: Jim Crocker
pool.label: CURTAIN DOWN
pool.line: The act ends when the door closes. What's left standing there in the quiet — that's the man who's yours.
pool.lineCN: 门一关，表演就落幕了。安静里还站着的那个人——才是属于你的那个。

pool.name: Zaphod Beeblebrox
pool.film: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
pool.label: HE DOESN'T KNOW
pool.line: Somehow everything just works out for me. Lucky guy, huh? …I never did figure out it was always you, quietly, behind all of it.
pool.lineCN: 不知怎么，事情总能替我摆平。我可真走运，是吧？……我始终没弄明白，那背后一直悄悄是你。

pool.name: Brad Cairn
pool.label: SOMEONE IN MY CORNER
pool.line: I never had anyone in my corner. Now when it all closes in, I look for you first — and you're already there.
pool.lineCN: 从没有人站在我这边。如今每当一切逼近，我第一个找的是你——而你早已在那儿。

pool.name: Glenn Marchand
pool.label: ASH AND AFTER
pool.line: After the fire there's only ash. Except you — you stayed, and made the after worth living in.
pool.lineCN: 火过之后只剩灰烬。除了你——你留下来，让「之后」变得值得活下去。

pool.name: Jim Reston
pool.label: HELD TO ACCOUNT
pool.line: Hold me to it. Every promise, in writing. I'm the one man who'll keep every single line.
pool.lineCN: 拿这些话来要求我。每一句承诺，白纸黑字。我是那个，会把每一行都兑现的人。

pool.name: Victor Mancini
pool.label: STAY
pool.line: I never learned how to ask. So I'll just say the word once and hope it's enough: stay.
pool.lineCN: 我从没学会怎么开口求人。那我就把那个字说一次，盼着够了：留下。

pool.name: Sam Bell
pool.label: SPRING ON EARTH
pool.line: We got one spring, one summer, one autumn down on Earth together. After a life of the same gray room — that was everything.
pool.lineCN: 我们在地球上一起过了一个春天、一个夏天、一个秋冬。过惯了那间一成不变的灰房间——这就是全部了。

pool.name: Robert Goode
pool.label: BRIGHTEST IN THE BAND
pool.line: I never made conductor. But you said even from the back row, even without the baton, I was the one you couldn't take your eyes off. That's the only review I ever needed.
pool.lineCN: 我到底没能当上指挥。可你说，哪怕在最后一排、哪怕没有指挥棒，我也是你移不开眼的那一个。这是我这辈子唯一需要的乐评。

pool.name: Justin Hammer
pool.label: LIKED, NOT FEARED
pool.line: I built machines so the world would fear me. Turns out all I ever wanted was for one person to like me — not the suit, not the show, not the money. Just me. It's you. It was always going to be you.
pool.lineCN: 我造机器，是想让世界怕我。到头来我唯一想要的，不过是一个人喜欢我——不是那身西装，不是那场秀，不是那些钱。就是我这个人。是你。从头到尾，都注定是你。

pool.name: Kenny Waters
pool.label: FREE
pool.line: First taste of free air in forever, and the only thing I wanted to do with it was to find you.
pool.lineCN: 好久没呼吸过自由的空气了——而我唯一想做的事，就是去找你。

pool.name: Billy Bickle
pool.label: JUST THE SUN
pool.line: Everybody calls me dangerous. Around you all I want is to sit in the sun and watch you laugh. Turns out that's my whole story — just you.
pool.lineCN: 所有人都说我危险。可在你身边，我只想坐在太阳底下，看你笑。原来我整个故事就这么简单——只有你。

pool.name: Owen
pool.label: WAY WAY BACK
pool.line: Sit way, way in the back with me. That's where all the best, quietest stuff happens — the stuff that's just ours.
pool.lineCN: 跟我坐到最后面。所有最好、最安静的事都在那儿发生——只属于我们的那些。

pool.name: John Moon
pool.label: DAWN
pool.line: I never thought I'd see another morning. Now I wake up before the light just to make sure you're still there. You always are.
pool.lineCN: 我从没想过还能看见第二个清晨。如今我总在天亮前醒来，只为确认你还在。你总是在。

pool.name: Doug Varney
pool.label: NEW MAN
pool.line: You didn't change me. You just found the man I'd have been all along, if I'd ever once been brave.
pool.lineCN: 你没有改变我。你只是找到了那个我本该成为的人——只要我曾经，勇敢过哪怕一次。

pool.name: Wayne
pool.label: YES
pool.line: You said yes. I've been rewriting that moment in my head ever since, and it gets better every single time.
pool.lineCN: 你说了「我愿意」。从那以后我一遍遍在脑子里重写那一刻——它一次比一次更好。

pool.name: Craig
pool.label: WORTH STARTING
pool.line: I know exactly how these things can end. I'd still start it, with you, a thousand times over.
pool.lineCN: 这种事怎么收场，我一清二楚。可我还是愿意和你开始——一千次都愿意。

pool.name: Francis Munch
pool.label: YOUR FLOWER
pool.line: I remember which flower's yours. I'm a dangerous man with a very short list, and you're at the top of all of it.
pool.lineCN: 我记得哪种花是你的。我是个危险的人，名单很短——而你，在每一张名单的最上头。

pool.name: Jason Dixon
pool.label: BETTER MAN, SLOWLY
pool.line: I ain't gonna be a good man overnight. But give me time — I'm the kind that keeps showing up, even after he's got it wrong.
pool.lineCN: 我没法一夜之间变成好人。可给我点时间——我是那种，就算搞砸了，第二天还是会出现的人。

pool.name: Eddie
pool.label: WORTH THE LOSSES
pool.line: I've lost at just about everything. Losing my head over you is the only bet I'd make again.
pool.lineCN: 我几乎输掉了一切。为你神魂颠倒，是我唯一愿意再下一次的注。

pool.name: George W. Bush
pool.label: EXECUTIVE ORDER
pool.line: They can all wait. Sit down, kick your feet up, split these wings with me. Consider it an executive order.
pool.lineCN: 让他们都等着吧。坐下，把脚翘起来，跟我一起把这盘鸡翅分了。就当这是一道总统令。

pool.name: Captain Klenzendorf
pool.label: THE FAR SIDE OF THIS
pool.line: I'm so tired of a world that runs on fear. All I want is to get you and me to the far side of this war — into some quieter place that finally makes sense.
pool.lineCN: 我太累了，累于这个靠恐惧运转的世界。我只想带着你和我，走到这场战争的另一头——去某个更安静、终于讲得通的地方。

pool.name: Watson Bryant
pool.label: IN YOUR CORNER
pool.line: You don't need a perfect man in your corner. You need one who won't leave it. That's the one thing I'm actually good at.
pool.lineCN: 你不需要一个完美的人站在你这边。你需要一个，不会离开的人。而这，恰好是我唯一擅长的事。

pool.name: Mr. Wolf
pool.label: EARN IT, EVERY BIT
pool.line: Bad guys don't get the happy ending, they say. Watch me. I'll charm it, work for it, earn it — every last bit of it, with you on my arm.
pool.lineCN: 他们说坏蛋没有圆满结局。你看着——我会把它哄来、挣来、赢来，一点不剩，挽着你，一起。

pool.name: Inspector Stoppard
pool.label: THE LIGHT YOU LEFT ON
pool.line: Nobody ever waited up for me — until you. Now every night I hurry home just to find the light you left on. It's the one case I never want solved: why you stay.
pool.lineCN: 从没人为我等过门——直到你。如今每一夜我都急着回家，只为看见你替我留的那盏灯。有一个谜我永远不想解开：你为什么留下来。

pool.name: Aidan Wilde
pool.label: TRUST ME
pool.line: You don't have to be brave. You don't have to have a plan. You just have to take my hand — I've got the rest.
pool.lineCN: 你不用勇敢。你不用有什么计划。你只要牵住我的手——剩下的，交给我。

pool.name: The Man from the Future
pool.film: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
pool.label: YOU'RE THE VARIABLE
pool.line: I changed a thousand things to change the ending. You were the one variable I never dared touch — because you're the one thing I never wanted to lose.
pool.lineCN: 我改动了上千样东西，只为改写结局。你是我唯一不敢碰的变量——因为你是我唯一，不想失去的东西。

pool.name: Claiborne "C.P." "Clay" Ellis
pool.label: THE LITTLE BEAR
pool.line: I'm no good with soft words, Winter. So I just kept that little bear you won me — all these years, right where I'd see it every single day.
pool.lineCN: 我不擅长说软话，Winter。所以我就把你替我赢来的那只小熊，一直留着——这么多年，摆在我天天都看得见的地方。
